summaries.en: Former Chungju Mayor Cho Gil-hyung resigned as a preliminary candidate for Chungbuk Governor and hinted at leaving the People Power Party, criticizing the party for not recognizing him and making him feel humiliated.
summaries.zh: 前忠州市长曹吉亨宣布辞去忠清北道知事预备候选人职务，并暗示将退出国民力量党，批评该党不认可他并让他感到受辱。
